# Generation 7 — Chesed Brainstorm

The Awtsmoos renews every public road while mutable worlds appear and flee;
Awtsmoos.com should reveal truthful SEO on every trusted domain without letting forged Hosts decree.

## Infinite possibility field

1. Record which exact sitemap advertised every crawled URL.
2. When an advertised page returns 404, refetch that exact source sitemap.
3. If the URL disappeared, classify it as crawl-time churn rather than a broken indexed road.
4. If the URL remains advertised, keep the 404 as a hard release failure.
5. Report churn separately so mutable data remains visible rather than silently ignored.
6. Keep transport retry semantics separate from HTTP verdicts.
7. Preserve full sitemap provenance across nested sitemap indexes.
8. Add deterministic fixtures for disappearing versus persistent 404 URLs.
9. Make tenant HTML SEO trust a server-side host policy instead of arbitrary Host headers.
10. Trust Awtsmoos-owned domains by suffix and exact root.
11. Trust localhost/127.x only for local development and verification.
12. Trust custom domains only when explicitly configured by deployment/hosting authority.
13. Never accept wildcard custom-host configuration from a request.
14. Strip/normalize host ports safely so custom-domain canonical identity is stable.
15. Unknown Host responses must not emit forged canonical, OpenGraph, Twitter, or JSON-LD URLs.
16. Prefer noindex for unknown unregistered hosts so mirrors cannot accidentally create duplicate indexed worlds.
17. Preserve authored metadata on trusted creator sites.
18. Fill only missing title/description/canonical/robots/social/schema vessels.
19. Keep private/edit/admin/query pages noindex.
20. Keep registered Awtsmoos pages on their fixed canonical metadata regardless of request Host.
21. Add security regressions proving attacker.example cannot mint canonical authority.
22. Add custom-domain regressions proving an explicitly trusted example domain gets its own HTTPS canonical.
23. Add Awtsmoos-subdomain regressions.
24. Add localhost-with-port regressions for runtime verification.
25. Keep DNS/TLS ownership outside HTML SEO; never pretend a domain is connected merely because a Host header arrived.
26. Document the hosting contract: custom DNS/TLS adapter binds the domain, then the SEO allowlist activates host-aware metadata automatically.
27. Later expose this host binding through a durable project publication registry rather than an environment string.
28. Later generate tenant-specific robots/sitemaps from the project publication graph once a public-domain adapter exists.
29. Keep all new modules under 120 lines, tab-indented, readable, and split by responsibility.
30. Rerun full SEO, Heichel, route, manifest, runtime, public crawl, guarded release, exact-SHA activation, and public verification.
